run_repro_explorer: run the explorer function to launch a SLURM grid search for Demucs model training reproducibility
configure_slurm_jobs: configure SLURM job settings with 8 GPUs and a 3-day time limit on devlab and learnlab partitions
bind_hyperparameters: bind EMA epoch and batch decay rates along with epoch count to the launcher for grid search
launch_model_variants: launch training jobs for base Demucs, normalized Demucs, and HDemucs model variants with SVD penalty
run_ablation_study: run an ablation study on the normalized Demucs model varying dconv LSTM, attention, mode, and GELU settings
